rows.note: This is the all-purpose conversational choice when asking someone to think about a matter again.

example.english: You should reconsider before agreeing so quickly.
example.traditional: 你不如再諗吓先，唔好咁快答應。
example.jyutping: nei5 bat1 jyu4 zoi3 nam2 haa2 sin1 m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 daap3 jing3

rows.note: Use this when the focus is on actually changing one's decision or intention.

example.english: I decided to reconsider and ultimately changed my mind about going on the trip.
example.traditional: 我最後改主意，決定唔去旅行。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 hau6 goi2 zyu2 ji3 kyut3 ding6 m4 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
